name: local-sync
description: Copies each file Claude changes under a source folder to the same path under a target folder (a local site's theme copy, say), one file at a time, and shows whether the result was checked in a browser

source_dir.title: Source folder
source_dir.description: The folder Claude edits, e.g. a theme folder inside your repo. Empty: the mod does nothing.

target_dir.title: Target folder
target_dir.description: Where each changed file is copied, at the same relative path, e.g. the local site's copy of that theme.

exclude.title: Skip these
exclude.description: Comma-separated folder or file names never copied.
